name: Kir Drax'in Extention (Guilds, Med Cent, Old Newbie Area)

rooms.name: Temple Medical Centre
rooms.desc:
Part of the Church's rule of Kir Drax'in involves medical care for its
citizenry.  This medical centre is far from modern though, using only
church approved techniques and technology.  Understandably, the mortality
rate is very high.

rooms.name: The Morgue
rooms.desc:
This large room looks more like a butcher shop than a mortuary,
with thick, dried pools of blood and bits of gore stuck to the floor.
Obviously, the smell here is less than pleasant and carries a distinct
wafe of chemicals.  The evil-looking man hunched over a shrouded body
may be your only hope of getting your possessions back, however.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There is a large wall to the north and west, but
it looks like you can leave to the east or south.

against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There are walls to the north and east, but it
looks like you can leave to the west and the south.

someone) to bits.  There is a wall here to the west and north, but
you can leave to the east and south.

great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  You seem to be able to leave in any direction.

great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There is a large wall directly to your east, but 
seem to be able to move north, west, or south.

against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the

someone) to bits.  There are large walls to your west and south, but
you seem to be able to move north and east.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  You can exit the arena to the south, and you seem
to be able to move to the west, north, or east.

rooms.name: The Arena
rooms.desc:
This area is for those frustrated adventurers to vent their anger
against other players.  This is a smaller arena than the one in the
great town of Kir Drax'in but it is big enough to hack something (or
someone) to bits.  There are large walls to your south and east, but
you seem to be able to move north and west.

rooms.name: Hall of Cells
rooms.desc:
This is a hallway to lead you to a few of the different types of
creatures that wander around this realm.  To the east you see a sign.
To look at this sign type "look sign".

rooms.name: Warg Kennels
rooms.desc:
There are some pretty vicious looking small animals here.  If you
slaughter them (That is why you're here, isn't it?) you can type "carve
corpse" to carve some meat off the corpse.

rooms.name: Cleric Guild
rooms.desc:
This young cleric is very experienced, despite his youth.  To learn
from him type "practice" and see what he has available for you.

rooms.name: Warrior Guild
rooms.desc:
This young warrior is very experienced, despite his youth.  To learn
from him type "practice" and see what he has available for you.

rooms.name: Hall of Cells
rooms.desc:
This is a hallway to lead you to a few of the different types of creatures
that you wander around this realm.  To the east you see a sign.  To look at
the sign type "look sign".

rooms.name: Wolf Kennels
rooms.desc:
This room looks like its been mauled by wolves.  Pretty dangerous 
creatures for someone of your level.

rooms.name: Cleric Antechamber
rooms.desc:
This room is meant to protect the cleric guildmaster from all harm and
danger.  There is a good-sized door to the north (where you imagine the
guildmaster would be.)  But unless you are a cleric, it would probably
not be advisable to try to go that direction.

rooms.name: Warrior Antechamber
rooms.desc:
This room is meant to protect the warrior guildmaster from all harm and
danger.  There is a good-sized door to the north (where you imagine the
guildmaster would be.)  But unless you are a warrior, it would probably 
not be advisable to try to go that direction.

rooms.name: Psionist Antechamber
rooms.desc:
As you stand in this sparsely decorated foyer, you feel your mind
probed by many unseen Psionics, perhaps even the guildmaster herself,
who lies in the room to the west.

rooms.name: Guild Hall
rooms.desc:
All young adventurers need a place to train.  This hallway provides
access to those resources.  You see a sign mounted on the wall here.

rooms.name: Guild Hall
rooms.desc:
All young adventurers need a place to train.  This hallway provides
access to those resources.  You see a sign mounted on the wall here.

rooms.name: Central Training Room
rooms.desc:
This room is almost directly in the center of this fine training facility,
the heart of which is the arena, directly north. Designed for new adventurers,
you can hear the shouts and cries of battle even from here. The exit of the
facility is a narrow ladder leading up.

rooms.name: A Training Room
rooms.desc:
This room looks like it's been heavily used for practicing various combat
techniques.  The walls have huge holes gouged out of them and are covered in
blood.

rooms.name: A Training Room
rooms.desc:
This room has the appearance of a room used for extensive combat training.
The bloodcaked walls lead you to believe that many a brave soul has died in
this room.

rooms.name: A Training Room
rooms.desc:
This room looks like it's been through rough times. The heavy wear and
tear on the walls, floor, and even the ceiling make this place look like
it hosted World War II.

rooms.name: Inside the Dojo
rooms.desc:
Light streams in from outside and refracts off the rice-paper walls,
turning the inside of this modest dwelling bright as day.  A few sparse
decorations -- a rack of katanas here, a painted scene of battle there,
a straw broom in the corner -- are all that decorate this place. 
   A doorway to the south marks the room of the guildmaster.

rooms.name: Mages Guild
rooms.desc:
This room is full of bottles and scrolls.  A perfect place to teach
the young magic-user the beginnings of magic.

rooms.name: The Back Room
rooms.desc:
The airy room is separated from the entrance to the north only by a thin
rice-paper wall. A small firepit has been dug in the dirt floor, over which
brews a pot of herb tea. The guildmaster stirs it slowly with a bamboo whisk,
eyeing you with a calm dignity.
   A colorfully painted divider leans against one wall, almost covering a
tunnel leading into the sewers under the city -- a safehouse for adventurers
on the run.

rooms.name: School Hallway
rooms.desc:
The SCORE command shows you what level you are and other vital statistics
about you.

rooms.name: Hall of Cells
rooms.desc:
This is a hallway to lead you to a few of the different types of
creatures that wander around this realm.  To the east you see a sign.
To look at this sign, type "look sign".

rooms.name: Mercenary Room
rooms.desc:
The phrase, "Hey wanna hire me?" comes to mind.  This room is not very
clean, but you can see the reflection of shiny and well-honed swords on
the ground.  You hope those aren't from slaughtered adventurers like
yourself.

rooms.name: Entrance to the Training Center
rooms.desc:
The purpose of this place is very clear: to help you get up to speed
with the basics of how to maneuver about the world. The first thing you
should do is stop being naked. The way to wear equipment is to use the
WEAR command. You can wear multiple things at one time by typing WEAR
ALL. Another command that you will find useful is the HELP command.

rooms.name: Training Room
rooms.desc:
A variety of tapestries line the walls here; depicting weapons of every
shape and size imaginable.  To use your weapon in battle, you must enter
WIELD <weapon name>.  Your <weapon name> is based on your class, and could
be a dagger, sword, katana, club, etc.
   To see what you are carrying, use the INVENTORY (or INV) command.

rooms.name: Training Room
rooms.desc:
In order to stay fit, you need to eat and drink. EAT <food name> where
<food name> is whatever you want to eat in your inventory (usually bread,
meat, or perhaps a magically created mushroom). Drink is the same way; 
DRINK WATER, for example.

rooms.name: Hall of Cells
rooms.desc:
This is a hallway to lead you to a few of the different types of 
creatures that you wander around this realm.  To the east you see
a sign.  To look at the sign, type "look sign".

rooms.name: Guard room
rooms.desc: Very clean and orderly, a fine band of people probably stay in this room.

rooms.name: Exit From Training
rooms.desc:
This is the exit from the facility, you can always come back later
to learn and practice your skills, but for now, you are most likely
fit for battle.  Adventure Well!

rooms.name: Exit From Cells
rooms.desc:
This is the exit from the hall of cells.  You can always come back later to
fight and hone your skills, but for now you are probably tired and ready for a
break -- or ready to try them in the real world.

rooms.name: Psionist Guild
rooms.desc:
Your mind is virtually overcome by the power in this room.  Except for some
straw mats on the floor and a stick of incense hanging from the ceiling, it is
empty of furnishings. A dark tunnel leads downward, seeming to call to you with
promises of adventure.

rooms.name: In The Tunnels
rooms.desc:
You stand in one of the near-black tunnels that catacomb the underworld
of the city above.  There seems to be no way back up, for the walls are
slippery with mold and slime.  Carved into the wall are some crude markings.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
This underground arena must lie directly beneath the heart of the city
of Kir Drax'in.  The cavern ceiling, several hundred feet above you, is lit
by a faint magical illumination, spreading a sickening greenish glow on the
battlefield beneath your feet.  
   The exit of the arena lies to the south, and the arena itself opens up
in all other directions.

rooms.name: In The Arena
rooms.desc:
The clashing sounds of battle echo all around you, and you stay near the
southwestern wall that rises up to meet the ceiling far above you.  A little
ways east of here lies the exit of the arena, and to the northeast you can
see a plethora of assorted corpses and battling groups of adventurers.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
The clashing sounds of battle echo all around you, and you stay near the
southeastern wall that rises up to meet the ceiling far above you.   A little
ways west of here lies the exit of the arena, and to the northeast you can
see a plethora of assorted corpses and battling groups of adventurers.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
You hug the western wall of the cavern here, staying out of the thick
of the fray.  Far to the southeast you see the arena exit; everywhere
else, only the grim tide of battle can be seen.  Corpses and bones litter
the ground in a vast profusion of decay and rot.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
You stand in dead-center of the arena, with battling figures all around
you.  Far to the south lies the exit of the arena, but all other directions
show the solid rock walls of the cavern that keep the battle contained in a
tight dome under what must be a bustling city above.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
You hug the eastern wall of the cavern here, staying out of the thick
of the fray.  Far to the southwest you see the arena exit; everywhere 
else, only the grim tide of battle can be seen.  Corpses and bones litter
the ground in a vast profusion of decay and rot.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
The clashing sounds of battle echo all around you, and you stay near the
northwestern wall that rises up to meet the ceiling far above you.  Far to
the southeast lies the exit of the arena, but between here and there lies a
raging battle.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
This underground arena must lie directly beneath the heart of the city
of Kir Drax'in. The cavern ceiling, several hundred feet above you, is lit
by a faint magical illumination, spreading a sickening greenish glow on
the battlefield beneath your feet. The exit of the arena lies far to the
south, across a battlefield overrun with warring figures.

rooms.name: In the Arena
rooms.desc:
The clashing sounds of battle echo all around you, and you stay near the
northeastern wall that rises up to meet the ceiling far above you.  Far to
the southwest lies the exit of the arena, but between here and there rages
a dozen small battles between unrecognizable beings.
